name: mark
label: Logo mark
help_text: White cut of the isotipo. It sits on the plum button and on the dark panel header, so it has to be the white one.

name: greeting
label: Greeting
default: Hi — I'm Atena. Tell me what's slowing your operation down and I'll tell you whether we're the right people for it.

name: greeting_es
label: Greeting (Spanish)
default: Hola, soy Atena. Cuéntame qué está frenando tu operación y te digo si somos los indicados para resolverlo.

name: disclaimer
label: AI disclosure line
default: AI answers — they can be wrong. Don't share passwords or payment details here.

name: disclaimer_es
label: AI disclosure line (Spanish)
default: Las respuestas son orientativas y pueden contener errores. No compartas contraseñas, datos de pago ni información confidencial.

name: starters
label: Opening questions
help_text: Shown as chips under the greeting until the visitor writes something. Keep them short. One row per question, each with both languages.

name: placeholder_es
label: Input placeholder (Spanish)
default: Escribe tu pregunta o describe el problema…

name: error_text
label: Error message
default: I couldn't answer right now. Try again, or write to us from the contact page.

name: error_text_es
label: Error message (Spanish)
default: No pude responder en este momento. Inténtalo de nuevo o escríbenos desde la página de contacto.

name: limit_text
label: Rate-limit message
default: You've reached the message limit for now. Write to us from the contact page and a person will reply.

name: limit_text_es
label: Rate-limit message (Spanish)
default: Has llegado al límite de mensajes por ahora. Escríbenos desde la página de contacto y te responde una persona.

name: endpoint
label: Function endpoint
help_text: Public URL of the chat serverless function.
